row_policy.cluster_average: exactly one row per randomized cluster; equal analysis weight unless the preregistered estimand says otherwise
row_policy.individual_average: one row per analysis unit; treatment must be constant within randomized cluster; weights must be preregistered

invariants: at least two clusters per arm before routing; adequacy remains a diagnostic, not a guarantee
cluster-average and individual-average estimands never silently substitute for each other
ordinary iid or individual-level robust standard errors are forbidden
non-finite values, singular design, non-positive effective degrees of freedom, or excessive leverage fail closed
